paper.title: Efficient Concurrent Updates to Persistent Randomized Binary Search Trees

risks: The inspected artifact is flagged as requiring privileged and cloud execution, which could complicate sandboxing, cost control, and reproducibility.
The probe only inspected the repository; it did not execute the build or benchmark, although a score-3 inspection is a full pass under the available probe.
Concurrent performance measurements can be noisy and hardware-sensitive, requiring pinned CPUs, warmups, repeated trials, and normalized scoring.
Correctness testing for persistent snapshots and races must be added to prevent throughput-only solutions from weakening consistency.
Adoption evidence is currently limited to one GitHub star and no citations, as expected for a very recent paper.
